name: Nobleman
overview: The Scriptures reveal the story of a nobleman who, upon hearing of Jesus' presence in Galilee, urgently sought His help to heal his critically ill son. Despite Jesus' initial challenge regarding belief without signs, the nobleman demonstrated faith by trusting Jesus' word that his son would live. This account highlights the power of Christ's authoritative word and the faith it inspires, as the nobleman’s belief was confirmed when his servants brought news of his son's recovery.
